topic: Managing 40 client work permits from one compliance dashboard — what the daily routine now looks like
format: Build a tight case study: type of company, the problem they had, what changed, the one number that proves it worked
post:
A staffing firm in Muscat was managing 40 client work permits across spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads, and calendar reminders — held together by one overworked PRO officer.

Renewal dates got missed. Clients called to chase updates. The PRO officer spent two hours every morning just figuring out what needed attention that day.

They moved to SmartPRO Hub in week one.

The morning routine is now 15 minutes.

One dashboard shows every permit status, expiry countdown, and pending Ministry of Labour filing across all 40 clients, sorted by urgency. Nothing lives in someone's inbox. Nothing depends on memory.

Zero missed renewals in the first 90 days. The PRO officer now handles a larger client load without adding headcount.

This is what permit tracking in Oman should look like — not a spreadsheet with 12 tabs, but something that flags what's urgent before it turns into a problem.

If you're managing more than 10 client permits manually right now, the risk isn't abstract. It's a Tuesday morning when three renewals are due and your PRO officer calls in sick.
